0022600216.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, first in the Northwest and third in the West) arrive on a four-game winning streak, with a 3-2 road record, while the Portland Trail Blazers (6-3, third in the Northwest and 1.5 games back, eighth in the West) are on a two-game losing streak after going 1-2 at home. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms) and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle). The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 124-95 win in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025, and no games between these teams have been played yet in 2026-27.
